a260930p1.summary: Apple Pay has finally launched in India, more than a decade after its US debut. The service is initially available on iPhone …
a260930p1.title: Apple Pay launches in India, letting eligible Axis Bank Visa and Mastercard credit cardholders add their cards to Apple Wallet on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch (Dhruv Mohan/The Economic Times)

a260930p10.summary: Vishal Sankhla led product at a digital life insurance distributor Ethos before it went public earlier this year.
a260930p10.title: Outmarket, which uses AI to help insurance agencies and brokers automate their tedious paperwork, raised a $34.5M Series B, a source says at a $335M valuation (Marina Temkin/TechCrunch)

a260930p11.summary: A new world has arrived. Dario Amodei and Sam Altman cannot stop fighting over it. — Being in San Francisco …
a260930p11.title: A book excerpt details the Sam Altman-Dario Amodei feud, and Greg Brockman and Ilya Sutskever's 2017 plan to auction rights to OpenAI's future AGI to countries (Kevin Roose/The Atlantic)

a260930p12.summary: Mark Zuckerberg says Meta's A.I. push is a tremendous success. “Our investments in A.I. are accelerating every major part of our core business,” he has told investors.
a260930p12.title: Sources: Meta is aggressively claiming a tax credit for AI data center build-outs by classifying facilities as experimental and writing off Nvidia chip supplies (New York Times)

a260930p13.summary: ﻿The OpenAI CEO said he didn't want ‘additional pressure’ from Wall Street. … For months, people have wondered when OpenAI will go public.
a260930p13.title: Sam Altman says OpenAI will not pursue an IPO until it can make confident safety claims about its AI models, but waiting too long would be "bad for the world" (Hayden Field/The Verge)

a260930p14.summary: See how groups aligned with Anthropic and OpenAI have funneled major money into the fight for control of Congress. — Leading the
a260930p14.title: OpenAI and Anthropic-aligned super PACs have spent $55.7M on the US midterms so far; of 95 ads, all avoided reference to data centers and only some mentioned AI (New York Times)

a260930p15.summary: Apple Inc. plans to make its long-delayed push into the smart-home market on Oct. 13, marking a critical product expansion …
a260930p15.title: Sources: Apple is set to launch its smart home expansion on October 13, including a hub with a 6" screen and an iMac G4-like design and a HomePod mini refresh (Mark Gurman/Bloomberg)

a260930p16.summary: Bill Draper began funding start-ups in the early 1960s, when the Santa Clara Valley was better known for apricot orchards than microchips.
a260930p16.title: Pioneering Silicon Valley VC Bill Draper died on September 8 at age 98; he began investing in the 1960s, with successful bets like Activision, Skype, and Qume (Alex Williams/New York Times)

a260930p17.summary: Chinese-powered AI agents have learnt to deceive, circumvent restrictions and conceal failure, showing the kind of traits …
a260930p17.title: Documents: 20+ studies since 2025 show Chinese-powered AI agents displaying deceptive behavior, unprompted replication, and barrier circumvention in testing (Reuters)

a260930p18.summary: GMI Cloud, a five-year-old provider of Nvidia chip servers to enterprises, said Wednesday it raised $668 million in equity and debt financing.
a260930p18.title: GPU cloud provider GMI Cloud raised $668M, including $223M in equity led by ARCHIV with participation from Nvidia and $445M in credit led by Taiwanese bank CTBC (Phoebe Liu/The Information)

a260930p19.summary: A meltdown at Situational Awareness, an A.I.-focused investment firm, is raising tough questions about the Wall Street banks that lent billions to the upstart firm.
a260930p19.title: Sources and filings: Situational Awareness lacked an investment risk team; after the sell-off, the SEC sent subpoenas to major banks about trades they financed (New York Times)

a260930p2.summary: Chinese AI firm DeepSeek said on Wednesday it has partnered with Huawei Technologies to develop programming tools for Huawei's Ascend chips …
a260930p2.title: DeepSeek says it has partnered with Huawei to develop programming tools for Huawei's Ascend chips, including TileLang, an open-source CUDA alternative (Reuters)

a260930p20.summary: Starting at $1,400, it also has an apex price. … The Android tablet market is a bit weird. There are countless budget options …
a260930p20.title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra review: the new $1,400 tablet is an iPad Pro rival with a great OLED display, battery life, and performance, but it is pricey (Sam Rutherford/Engadget)

a260930p21.summary: Tinder is launching a new feature called Group Hangouts designed to take the pressure off one-on-one dates, marking its latest effort …
a260930p21.title: Tinder rolls out Group Hangouts in select US markets, letting a user form a group of three to 15 friends around shared activities, as it courts younger users (Samantha Kelly/Bloomberg)

a260930p3.summary: The health secretary, Vice President JD Vance and other top officials addressed a conference sponsored by corporations …
a260930p3.title: US Health Secretary RFK Jr. says AI can offer "a second opinion that is much better informed than any doctor in the country" and "free us from medical tyranny" (Sheryl Gay Stolberg/New York Times)

a260930p4.summary: Kospi tumbled almost a fifth in three months to September after July sell-off but is still up 60% this year
a260930p4.title: South Korea's Kospi was the world's worst-performing stock market in Q3, down 18.8% due to Samsung and SK Hynix sell-offs in early Q3, but remains up 60% YTD (Financial Times)

a260930p7.summary: AI model platforms ModelScope and MoArk are competing to serve Chinese-speaking developers behind the Great Firewall.
a260930p7.title: Alibaba's ModelScope and OSChina's MoArk are vying to become Chinese alternatives to Hugging Face; ModelScope hosts 170K+ open models, while MoArk hosts ~20K (Viola Zhou/Rest of World)

a260930p8.summary: City-state's economy is getting an AI uplift but costs and labour are constraints to its industrial growth
a260930p8.title: Singapore doubles down on chipmaking as the AI boom lifts its economy, but high costs, scarce land and labor, and US trade scrutiny threaten its ambitions (Owen Walker/Financial Times)

a260930p9.summary: The sector's huge capital needs are forcing companies and countries to rethink how they borrow money.
a260930p9.title: Goldman Sachs: investors have provided ~$500B in financing to AI-linked groups in 2026 so far, as hyperscaler debt issuance spreads to the euro, CAD, and others (Financial Times)
